description: Create a new, empty Playground project owned by the signed-in user. For a fresh generation request with no named, linked or conversation-established project, create one automatically with a concise name from the brief; do not ask for separate project-creation permission or inspect unrelated projects first. Reuse its ID for follow-up work on the same task. General questions do not need a project. Creation spends no credits; paid generation still requires a quote and user approval. Returns the project ID and canvasUrl.

name.description: Concise project name describing the user’s creative task.
